trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is no separate task behind it. Work through this guide's checklist from top to bottom; the progress bar at the top of the page shows exactly which trophies are still open.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the very first mission of Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks automatically when the mission ends, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 through to its end. The trophy pops as Chapter 2 opens — it is a story trophy, so just keep playing the main missions and it will come on its own.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 2 through to its end. The trophy pops as Chapter 3 opens. It is a story trophy and cannot be missed — but do the Chapter 2 side content on the way, because several other trophies unlock from missions in this chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 through to its end. The trophy pops as Chapter 4 opens. Chapter 3 is where several side questlines start — Andy, Randy and Tyrone — so pick those up while you are here.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 through to its end. The trophy pops as the final chapter opens. It is a story trophy and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. This is the gold story trophy. Note: the guides disagree on which chapter the finale belongs to — one source ties it to a Chapter 4 mission, another lists a Chapter 5 mission after it — so this guide does not pin a chapter number on it. Just finish the story and it pops.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. The trophy unlocks during that mission. Breakfast Run is also the mission that opens partner free-roam, which several other trophies need.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. The trophy unlocks during that mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. The trophy unlocks during that mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. The trophy unlocks during that mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. The trophy unlocks during that mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy unlocks during that mission and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game. The 100% checklist opens after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — and progress you made during the story already counts toward it, so do not wait until the end to start. It asks for roughly 60% true completion: 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 50 of 66 weapons, any 100 optional missions, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and 15 of 18 meditations. A few categories must be finished in full: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races and all of Bret's quests. Nothing on the list is missable — everything can be done in post-story free-roam. See the Roadmap tab for the full breakdown.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. The categories can be mixed, and under-the-bridge runs are the quickest way to build the total. Keep in mind the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this trophy unlocks on the way there. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what is still open under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Most of these happen naturally while you chase the other trophies, so this one usually pops without a dedicated effort.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 locations. All 42 gold medals are also required for the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut around them — work through the ranges one location at a time and repeat a challenge until the gold score lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total. All of them are also required for the 100% checklist, so clear them as part of the cleanup step of the roadmap rather than as a separate grind.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations in total, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need — pick the ones that suit your driving and skip the rest. Races also feed the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing location marked with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at it.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all of its levels once; the extra challenges are not needed. Four games count: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the home TV, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. Available from Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, playing as Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: a call from Andy, then her address in Belville. Her quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The questline is still available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It is marked in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton; look for the green KR icon in Key Lento. Dive for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — use the metal detector on the ocean floor — and bring it back. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2 and 3, so it is not missable. Track progress under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. His quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. The questline is still available after the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain questlines count — confirmed so far are Kirk and the Skunk Ape, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, with more yet to be discovered. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy, so do not rely on them. All of it is available in post-story free-roam, and progress shows in the trophy tracker.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It unlocks in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy — that mission also unlocks the Key Cloner. Deliver 16 sports cars he wants; track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and look for the green RK icon in west Vice City. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check the wishlist, and deliver them in good condition for more pay. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, playing as Jason. It is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy Synthetic Labs in Vice City in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, then the second quest, Spin On This, unlocks the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts as two. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING — the only potentially missable trophy in the game: one meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. In the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen, then goes to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe; it is still unconfirmed whether that spot is required for the trophy. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which happens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Only 15 of the 18 spots are needed for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel, playing as Jason. After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Bret texts Jason; the first quest is Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up again at any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck. All 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist. Which exact animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed — work through the decks and it will come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total, so you only need three of them — pick the sets whose cards you keep finding and finish those first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations — hold Up for the app, then R1 to scan a scannable object. Any 100 count, and there are more than 100 to find: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan as you travel and this pops without a dedicated hunt.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there. Track them under Progress, then Challenges.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Earliest chance is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when partner free-roam opens — call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle. A good escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, while robbing large bank vaults.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. You need both characters together, which is possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Keep the flashing wanted level — not the red heat level — and note the pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; a fourth shop may be needed.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The easiest way is to WAiNK-scan vehicles on a busy road — hold Up for the app, R1 to scan. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and 200 base models are needed for the 100% checklist. Track progress under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus — press L3 and R3 while aiming to slow time; it drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks and Adrenaline to extend it, wear body armor, and use an assault rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Your focus level rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal — easiest at terminals E3 and E4. Enter through the stairs by the boarding bridge or through the terminal itself. Drive the plane back to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is delayed, so keep flying until it lands.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get into a tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun — a silent lockpick — and jewelry store robberies. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun; do not kick the door, which triggers the alarm. Find the safe code note in the back room and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. It unlocks through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, enter while the vault is open, and bring your partner along to carry a second bag. Afterwards Yasmani sells security-van tips for $10,000, once his earlier Payday Loans quests are done. Robbing a vault gives an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist. Up to $205,000 per bank.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission as Maximum Withdrawal — robbing a bank vault counts. The earlier method also works: block an armored truck near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow map icons when you are nearby. All 39 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way there. Track them under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed. As of 19 November 2026 no verified unlock method exists — the guide PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. This guide will not guess a method: the official description is all we can confirm for now, and the guide will be updated once the community confirms how it unlocks.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed. As of 19 November 2026 no verified unlock method exists — the guide PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. This guide will not guess a method: the official description is all we can confirm for now, and the guide will be updated once the community confirms how it unlocks.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway — blow it open with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation. You reach the bowling alley during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police. It is not missable: the robbery icon respawns, and any items left behind can be taken later.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check it under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength — the heart icon. Work out together: call your partner with hold Right plus Triangle, and the partner trains automatically while you work out. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story. Only possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — track the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, set to On, to see each action as it registers — a demon-face icon. Profiles run from Professional for stealthy, clean escapes, through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is permanent if violence stays excessive. It happens passively while you chase the other trophies, and can be farmed late by running over civilians and cops if needed.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed. As of 19 November 2026 no verified unlock method exists — the guide PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. It is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is only a guess, so this guide does not present it as fact. The guide will be updated once the community confirms how it unlocks.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed. As of 19 November 2026 no verified unlock method exists — the guide PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. It is believed to come from a UFO questline, but that is only a guess, so this guide does not present it as fact. The guide will be updated once the community confirms how it unlocks.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed. As of 19 November 2026 no verified unlock method exists — the guide PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. It is believed to come from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but that is only a guess, so this guide does not present it as fact. The guide will be updated once the community confirms how it unlocks.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts — cumulative, not all at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It comes naturally with the bank-vault robberies for the 100% checklist; one vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative. The fastest way is expensive items: guns, car mods and tattoos. For reference, the state holds 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages — the 4 story-related garages do not count. Total cost is $160,000. They are available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); buy them through the Vice City Real Estate phone app. The fastest money for them comes from robberies in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy garages first — see Little Boxes — for parking spots, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray plus Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
